parameters.text:
=Compile these individual fact checks into a comprehensive report.

Original text: {{ $('Set Check Config').item.json.text_to_check }}
Fact check results: {{ JSON.stringify($json.data) }}

Return JSON:
{
  "overall_accuracy": "high/medium/low",
  "accuracy_score": 0,
  "true_claims": 0,
  "false_claims": 0,
  "partially_true": 0,
  "false_claim_details": [{"claim": "", "correction": ""}],
  "verified_claims": [],
  "trust_verdict": "trustworthy/questionable/unreliable",
  "summary": "2-3 sentence summary of fact check findings"
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - AI Response Fact-Checker
Extracts all verifiable factual claims from any text.
Perplexity checks each claim against current web sources.
GPT-4o compiles findings into accuracy report.

Verdict: TRUE / PARTIALLY TRUE / FALSE per claim.
Final trust score: trustworthy / questionable / unreliable.

Built for: verifying AI outputs before publishing, checking news claims, auditing research summaries.
